title: CodeChallenge: Token count by subword length (part 1)

cues.en: In this code challenge, you will continue exploring the relationship between tokens and whole words using real text data.
cues.zh: 這個程式挑戰會繼續使用真實文字資料，探索 token 與完整單字之間的關係。

cues.en: The goal of the first exercise is to determine whether there is a relationship between the number of tokens, in a word, and the number of characters in that word.
cues.zh: 第一個練習要判斷，單字的 token 數，是否與它的字元數有關。

cues.en: Now, I imagine you already have the intuition that longer words require more tokens, and that is the case.
cues.zh: 我想，你已經直覺知道，較長單字需要更多 token，而確實如此。

cues.en: But the relationship is not trivial as you will discover.
cues.zh: 不過，關係並沒有那麼單純，你很快就會發現。

cues.en: Okay, so start by importing the GPT four tokenizer and the text of the time machine.
cues.zh: 先匯入 GPT-4 tokenizer，以及《時間機器》的文字。

cues.en: Then you want to create words by splitting the text by whitespace.
cues.zh: 接著，依空白字元切分文字，取得單字。

cues.en: Now, by the way, when we say whitespace in the context of text processing, that includes spaces and tabs and newline characters.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，文字處理中的空白字元，包含空白、定位字元與換行字元。

cues.en: So this is not only About the spacebar.
cues.zh: 所以，不只是空白鍵輸入的空白。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And you should also include punctuations in here.
cues.zh: 這裡也要包含標點符號。

cues.en: So you're going to get periods and commas and colons being included as words.
cues.zh: 因此，句點、逗號與冒號，也會被當成單字。

cues.en: So technically this is more than just words but the punctuations will be relevant for later exercises.
cues.zh: 嚴格說，不只是單字，但後面的練習會用到這些標點。

cues.en: Now this is an imperfect way to split text.
cues.zh: 這種文字切分方式並不完美。

cues.en: We are not dealing with special characters and formatting characters and so on.
cues.zh: 沒有處理特殊字元、格式字元等等。

cues.en: But this is certainly good enough for our purposes here.
cues.zh: 但對這裡的目的而言，已經足夠。

cues.en: Anyway, in a for loop over all of the words, tokenize each word, and then count the number of characters in each word.
cues.zh: 接著用 for 迴圈走訪所有單字，對每個單字斷詞，並計算各自的字元數。

cues.zh: x 軸是以字元數表示的單字長度，y 軸則是每個單字的 token 數。
